title: Design System: ZERO EX · 灯光控制

platform.visualAuthority: Native Windows 11 Fluent, explicitly selected by the user
platform.units: Source dimensions are WinUI DIP. Frontmatter px preserves their numeric value. Screenshot pixels depend on scaling.
platform.themeBehavior: OS light/dark theme; no RequestedTheme override; XamlControlsResources merged in App.xaml.
platform.previewPolicy: HTML/CSS entries are self-contained system-color reference projections for the design panel. They do not reproduce WinUI templates, certify accessibility, or replace the native resource bindings below.

swatchStroke.use: One-DIP swatch/sequence outlines and footer separator

primaryAction.use: Static Apply and custom Start buttons

otherControls.use: Native TabView, buttons, ComboBox, GridView/ListView, NumberBox, CheckBox, HyperlinkButton, InfoBar, ContentDialog, selection, focus, hover, pressed and disabled states

controlFill.use: Sequence container and initial playback preview fill

title.use: 鼠标灯光 and 自定义

subtitle.use: 选择颜色, 颜色库 and 播放序列

default.resource: Inherited WinUI system font and language fallback

nativeTypography.policy: Do not freeze resolved native font family, role size, line height, or language fallback. Only explicit source overrides appear in frontmatter.

guidance.purpose: Operational notes, row timing summaries, draft-save state and playback detail

device-magenta.purpose: Exact physical LED choice; retain the user-facing label 紫色

device-white.purpose: Exact physical LED choice; outline remains visible

extensions.tonalRampPolicy: No synthetic brand ramps. Preserve the seven exact selectable endpoints; explicit custom playback and offline preview interpolate intermediate RGB values. Native UI theme colors remain resource references.

elevation.strategy: Flat native page surface; borders and standard control states provide structure; native window and dialog templates own their depth.

extensions.motionPolicy: No decorative UI animation tokens. Explicit custom light loops and offline preview are functional. A 50-ms playing/200-ms paused UI timer is separate from hardware sends spaced at least 450 ms apart; activity gating freezes the hardware timeline and stops automatic HID commands after about two seconds idle.

windowConstraints.minimumImplementation: OverlappedPresenter.PreferredMinimumWidth / PreferredMinimumHeight multiplied by current DPI scale; refreshed on XamlRoot.Changed

scrolling.owner: Lighting tab ScrollViewer and custom editor CustomScroll; custom footer is outside the scroll region

windowConstraints.responsiveBehavior: Both tab headers fill half the available strip. Lighting ItemsWrapGrid fits at most four columns; compact source palette fits at most seven and wraps independently. Custom editor scrolls above a pinned footer. No authored breakpoint.

playbackFooter.layout: Grid row Auto below flexible scrolling editor row

nativeStateSemantics.initial: Lighting tab selected; wireless and first color selected; Apply/Restore disabled; restore-on-exit unchecked; normal exit retains the last applied color. Custom loads local draft or starts empty and never auto-starts playback.
nativeStateSemantics.busy: Competing operations and sequence editing disabled; close cancelled until operation finishes.
nativeStateSemantics.selection: Static palette selection is preview only until Apply. Sequence edits and offline preview perform no HID access.
nativeStateSemantics.status: Lighting Status remains open and nonclosable. CustomStatus starts closed, is closable, and mirrors operation status in the pinned footer. Severity and native glyphs retain text semantics; started playback is not measured telemetry.
nativeStateSemantics.failedExitRestoration: Explicit restoration opt-in only: native ContentDialog; Close/Default=返回恢复; Primary=保留当前设置退出.
nativeStateSemantics.normalExit: Stop and await playback, then retain last applied color by default. RetainCurrentOnExit saves a local marker only; it adds no restore/off HID command. A host-driven loop cannot continue after exit.
nativeStateSemantics.failedExitRecord: Local retention record save failure: native ContentDialog; Close/Default=返回; Primary=保留当前设置退出.

accessibility.paletteSemantics: Native single-selection GridView, visible color-name text and ColorChoice.ToString() returning Name; selected name/hex repeated below.
accessibility.controls: Native labels, focus, selection, keyboard interaction, disabled states and severity semantics retained.
accessibility.verificationLimits: Saved reports cover native controls and DataPackage insertion, not live drag pointer gestures. Dark/high-contrast themes, keyboard focus traversal and screen-reader output remain unexercised; native inheritance is not a test result.
accessibility.fadeTimeName: 所选颜色过渡到下一色的秒数
accessibility.alternatives: Add Selected Color and Up/Down buttons supplement native drag/drop and reorder.

evidence.captureState: Bottom capture is intentionally scrolled; other captures show page tops. Diagnostic populated drafts do not auto-populate ordinary launch.
evidence.reviewDisposition: ship; no material fixes; full-strip half-width tabs confirmed across all five captures
evidence.sleepAcceptanceScope: Prior physical sleep-off evidence is limited to tested wireless firmware 3.01. Configuration read-back, visual review and command silence do not independently prove LED extinction on every state/current binary.

resourceOverride.purpose: Remove the native per-tab width cap so both fixed tabs fill the available strip equally; the large ceiling is not a target tab width.

tabNavigation.switchBehavior: Retains controls/session/player state and issues no device operation itself.

customSequence.entry: Copy color by native drag/drop or Add Selected Color
customSequence.ordering: Native ListView reorder plus explicit Up/Down buttons; Remove/Clear available
customSequence.persistence: Local Presets/custom-sequence.json under AppContext.BaseDirectory; autosave editing and load on ordinary launch
customSequence.preview: Valid offline loop, no hardware access
customSequence.start: Valid loop, idle controller and shared wireless connection required
customSequence.stop: Preview stops without hardware change; hardware playback stops and restores original settings
customSequence.previewTruth: Sequence sample, index/next-index and RGB hex; read-back is configuration verification, not optical telemetry.

activityGate.source: Passive Windows Raw Input filtered to this mouse actual movement/button activity
activityGate.idleBehavior: Freeze timeline and stop all automatic HID commands
activityGate.resumeBehavior: Physical activity resumes from frozen position
activityGate.hardwareChannel: Verified configuration-write channel; dedicated volatile animation channel and long-duration endurance are not established.

applicationIcon.scope: Original application identity asset only: executable, native window/titlebar and taskbar role. No general interface palette, type, layout or control styling change.
applicationIcon.geometry: Original upright geometric mouse silhouette, continuous colored perimeter, dark body, split-button lines and white wheel; no lettering or decorative glow.
applicationIcon.contour: Linear cyan-blue-magenta gradient, blue stop at 0.48; confined to the icon asset.
applicationIcon.paletteBoundary: Asset-local colors are not general UI tokens and do not replace native WinUI theme resources or the seven selectable device endpoints.

integration.deployment: Content copies ICO to output and publish using PreserveNewest
integration.window: MainWindow.xaml.cs AppWindow.SetIcon with Assets/ZeroExLight.ico under AppContext.BaseDirectory

evidence.limits: Native titlebar and icon resource checks were supplied; a separate taskbar capture was not supplied. Icon review does not reverify hardware behavior or broader UI accessibility/theme paths.

exitPolicy.normalExit: Retain last applied static color after stopping and awaiting host playback; save intentional retention locally without a restore/off command.
exitPolicy.optInRestore: Explicitly checking restore-on-exit restores the original configuration on close; an originally disabled light may extinguish.
exitPolicy.manualActions: Manual Restore and explicit hardware Stop/Restore retain restoration behavior; closing the application is a separate choice.
exitPolicy.sleepConstraint: Original firmware sleep-off behavior remains mandatory; no sleep parameter change, keepalive or polling is introduced.

guidance.defaultLighting: 默认退出保留最后设置的颜色，循环渐变随软件退出而停止。
guidance.restoreLighting: 退出时恢复原灯光配置，原配置关闭时灯会熄灭。
guidance.defaultCustom: 退出保留最后颜色。静置后仍按原设置休眠熄灯。
guidance.restoreCustom: 退出将恢复原灯光。静置后仍按原设置休眠熄灯。

exitPolicy.recovery: RetainedOnExit preserves the original snapshot, backup file and modified-address list; next connection distinguishes intentional retention from interruption. New write or manual restore clears the marker before mutation.

evidence.captureScope: Default wide/narrow images are scrolled settings viewports, not full-page or document-bottom captures; opt-in shows checked state and custom shows pinned guidance.
evidence.ownerObservation: Cyan remained after app exit and during normal mouse movement.
evidence.limits: Retention evidence does not independently expand prior firmware sleep-off acceptance. Dark/high-contrast themes, keyboard traversal and screen-reader output were not reverified by this documentation update.

narrative.overview:
The user chose C# and WinUI 3 for a focused operating utility. Windows supplies its visual authority: ordinary solid surfaces, native controls, the system accent, native keyboard feedback, and the operating system's light or dark theme. This captures the reviewed implementation and merges the provisional design notes; it does not establish a separate brand identity.

Use a clear, moderately spaced control surface that helps the owner connect, apply a color or arrange a looping sequence, and restore the saved settings. Strong saturated color belongs inside device-color and playback previews. State text and native status components explain connection, verification, and recovery without simulated telemetry. Functional gradients belong to explicitly started light playback and its offline preview. Sleep behavior and recovery acceptance remain defined by PRODUCT.md.
keyCharacteristics: Native WinUI controls and theme resources.
Explicit Apply, playback, and Restore actions with visible operation status.
Equal full-strip tabs, scrolling editors, and a pinned custom-playback footer.
Readable Chinese labels and standard keyboard and accessibility semantics.

rules.name: Native Theme
rules.body: Preserve resource-based surfaces, text, accent, selection, and focus instead of copying sampled screenshot colors.

rules.name: Device Color
rules.body: Preserve the seven exact selectable endpoint colors. Intermediate colors are functional sequence interpolation and preview, not an application-brand tonal ramp or decorative UI gradient. The independently authored application icon is a scoped identity-asset exception described in Components; its contour colors do not become interface tokens.

rules.name: Equal Tabs
rules.body: Each of the two fixed headers occupies half of the available strip at every supported window width; equal sizing must not stop at the native per-tab width cap.

rules.name: Activity Gate
rules.body: Explicitly started hardware playback uses passive Raw Input for this mouse's actual movement/button activity. About two seconds without activity freezes sequence time and stops automatic HID commands; physical activity resumes it. Preserve firmware sleep settings, avoid HID polling and keepalive, and retain explicit Stop/Restore.

dos: **Do** inherit Windows themes, system accent, native focus states, and language fallback.
**Do** preserve all seven named swatches and the selected name/hex text.
**Do** keep Apply and Restore explicit, readable, and reachable at the minimum window size.
**Do** show actual connection, backup, verification, and recovery outcomes in text.
**Do** retain vertical scrolling and wrapping guidance when space is constrained.
**Do** keep both tab headers half-width and the custom playback/recovery controls pinned while its editor scrolls.
**Do** distinguish user-arranged light gradients and offline preview from decorative interface motion and measured device telemetry.
donts: **Don't** turn device-output colors into general interface branding or replace native theme resources with sampled hex values; the original application icon is the sole scoped identity-asset exception.

**Don't** add decorative images or decorative gradients inside the interface, ornamental dashboard cards, or motion competing with the functional sequence preview; retain the original icon in its native application-identity role.
**Don't** present simulated battery, device details, or sleep verification as observed hardware state.
**Don't** add HID polling, keepalive, automatic playback on launch, or playback writes after the mouse activity gate closes.
**Don't** remove native labels, selection feedback, keyboard operation, or the visible recovery path.
